#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

struct Vec {
    static constexpr double EPS = 1e-9;
    double x, y;

    Vec(double x_=0, double y_=0) : x(x_), y(y_) {}

    Vec add(const Vec& o) const {
        return Vec(x + o.x, y + o.y);
    }

    Vec sub(const Vec& o) const {
        return Vec(x - o.x, y - o.y);
    }

    Vec scale(double s) const {
        return Vec(x * s, y * s);
    }

    double dot(const Vec& o) const {
        return x * o.x + y * o.y;
    }

    double cross(const Vec& o) const {
        return x * o.y - y * o.x;
    }

    double mag2() const {
        return dot(*this);
    }

    double mag() const {
        return sqrt(mag2());
    }

    Vec unit() const {
        double m = mag();
        if (m < EPS) return Vec(0, 0);
        return scale(1.0 / m);
    }

    Vec rot90() const {
        return Vec(-y, x);
    }

    Vec rot270() const {
        return Vec(y, -x);
    }

    bool equals(const Vec& o) const {
        return eq(x, o.x) && eq(y, o.y);
    }

    static bool eq(double a, double b) {
        return fabs(a - b) < EPS;
    }
};

struct Circle {
    Vec center;
    double radius;

    Circle(const Vec& c, double r) : center(c), radius(r) {}

    vector<Vec> intersect(const Circle& o) const {
        if (center.equals(o.center)) return {};
        Vec dir = o.center.sub(center);
        double d2 = dir.mag2();
        double d = sqrt(d2);
        if (radius + o.radius < d + Vec::EPS || radius + d < o.radius + Vec::EPS || o.radius + d < radius + Vec::EPS)
            return {};
        if (Vec::eq(radius + o.radius, d))
            return { center.add(dir.scale(radius / d)) };
        if (Vec::eq(o.radius + d, radius))
            return { center.sub(dir.scale(radius / d)) };
        double d1 = (radius * radius + d2 - o.radius * o.radius) / (2 * d);
        double h = sqrt(max(0.0, radius * radius - d1 * d1));
        Vec unitDir = dir.unit();
        Vec rInt = center.add(unitDir.scale(d1).add(unitDir.rot90().scale(h)));
        Vec lInt = center.add(unitDir.scale(d1).add(unitDir.rot270().scale(h)));
        return { rInt, lInt };
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<Circle> circles(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        double x, y;
        int r;
        cin >> x >> y >> r;
        circles[i] = Circle(Vec(x, y), r);
    }

    vector<Vec> points;
    vector<int> parent(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) parent[i] = i;
    int result = 1;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        vector<Vec> newPoints;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (i == j) continue;
            vector<Vec> intersections = circles[i].intersect(circles[j]);
            if (intersections.empty()) continue;
            int a = parent[i] = parent[parent[i]];
            int b = parent[j] = parent[parent[j]];
            parent[a] = b;
            for (const Vec& v : intersections) {
                bool exists = false;
                for (const Vec& e : newPoints) {
                    if (v.equals(e)) {
                        exists = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!exists) newPoints.push_back(v);
            }
        }
        result += (int)newPoints.size();
        for (const Vec& v : newPoints) {
            bool found = false;
            for (const Vec& e : points) {
                if (v.equals(e)) {
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!found) points.push_back(v);
        }
    }

    result -= (int)points.size();

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        result += 1 - (int)abs((i - parent[i]) > 0 ? 1 : -1);
    }

    cout << result << "\n";

    return 0;
}
